headline: Renovated warehouse becomes permanent home of African Futures Institute in Ghana
context: A former tile warehouse in Accra, Ghana, has been transformed into the headquarters of the African Futures Institute, an independent architecture school founded by Ghanaian-Scottish architect Lesley Lokko. Designed by Lokko with designer Fred Swart and architects Patrick Gentilez

sources.name: Dezeen
sources.summary: A former tile warehouse in Accra, Ghana, has been transformed into the headquarters of the African Futures Institute, an independent architecture school founded by Ghanaian-Scottish architect Lesley Lokko. Designed by Lokko with designer Fred Swart and architects Patrick Gentilezza, Patti Anahory and Laurence Lord, the renovated building contains research and education spaces for the school The post Renovated warehouse becomes permanent home of African Futures Institute in Ghana appeared first on Dezeen .
